title: SoPhyFit-Evap: Soil physics fitting tool for evaporation-method retention and conductivity data
description:
SoPhyFit-Evap fits soil water retention and unsaturated hydraulic conductivity curves to HYPROP evaporation-method data with six models (van Genuchten-Mualem, Brooks-Corey, Kosugi, bimodal van Genuchten, and the PDI variants with film flow), using a simultaneous error-weighted fit. It reports all parameters, field capacity, wilting point, plant-available water, pore classes and the fitted curves with 95% confidence intervals.

This record contains the Windows installer (SoPhyFit-Evap_Setup_<version>.exe), the user guide and the documentation. Releases: https://github.com/Tum-Soil-Biophysics/SoPhyFit-Evap/releases
